name: Iron
desc: Heavy, rust-red, everywhere: bunk frames, ducts, hull ribs, most of what gets bent into a tool.
notes: Ore arrives on the ore haul (sys_ore_haul); scrap from the spine. The commonest unit of the loop.

name: Copper
desc: Red wire metal, the cheapest way to carry current and the first thing scavengers strip.
notes: Copper ore off the haul, wire tangles and dead boards from the spine.

name: Light metal
desc: Pale alloy for housings, ladders and anything that has to be lifted by one person.
notes: Bauxite off the haul; duct junk and hull offcuts from salvage.

name: Noble metal
desc: Gold-bright flakes that never corrode. Contacts, jewellery, the fillings in better teeth.
notes: Only trace amounts in e-waste; traders bring flakes. Also what the tithe collectors like best.

name: Rare earths
desc: Grey dust that makes magnets, screens and chips possible. There is never enough of it.
notes: Trace amounts in dead appliances and e-waste; the crusher is the only fair way to get it out.

name: Lithium
desc: White salt that holds a charge. Every cell on the station is built around it.
notes: Wholesale crates and dead cell husks. A shortage here stalls the power chain.

name: Silicate
desc: Grit and glass in the making: the stony half of every ore, and what slag is.
notes: Comes in with ore, goes out as slag, rubble or glass. Cheap, bulky, always there.

name: Carbon
desc: Black dust: filter beds, electrodes, pencil lead, the soot in every duct.
notes: Spent filters and burnt-out husks are the main supply. Filters eat it back.

name: Polymer
desc: Grey plastic: casings, pipe, sheet, insulation. The spine runs on it.
notes: Everything cheap is made of it, so everything cheap comes back as flakes.

name: Fibre
desc: Lint, cloth and paper pulp: what soft things and flat things are made of.
notes: Rags from the spine, lint from filters and bedding. Boxes are made of it too.

name: Biomass
desc: Grey growing-stuff: the base of everything edible and half of what is not.
notes: Fed to vats, made from sludge by the digester. Rations are mostly this.

name: Water
desc: Never quite clean. Ice melts into it, the reclaimers cycle it, bodies take it back.
notes: Comes in as comet ice (sys_ice_haul); leaves by being drunk, or by the vent when it is too foul to save.

name: Salts
desc: Dried residue: table salt, mineral cake, what is left when water is boiled off.
notes: Precipitates out of reclaimed water and digester runs. Feeds scrubbers and brines.

name: Reagent
desc: Crude chemical liquor, mixed and uncertain. A chemist can work with it.
notes: Dregs from the clinic and the foundry. Medicine starts here.

name: Volatiles
desc: Gas held under pressure: oxygen, nitrogen, methane, whatever the ice gave up.
notes: Outgassed from comet ice and cracked from sludge. Bladders hold it until it is needed.

name: Sludge
desc: What is left when nothing else can be made of it. Brown, thick, unavoidable.
notes: Waste of every pass through the recycler. The digester can turn it back; otherwise it leaves by the vent port and only there.
